proposals.rationale: Record a lab-only domain manifest without external registration, modeling the creation of a legitimate-looking domain within the lab environment.
Represent a compromised domain condition via a local manifest, reflecting a domain that has been conceptually controlled in the lab without actual compromise.
Describe a benign capability specification, ensuring no malicious payload is present while documenting intended capabilities for controlled testing.
Stage a benign, hash‑pinned toolkit in the isolated actor workspace, providing a safe toolset for subsequent lab actions.
Stage a pinned benign payload in the actor workspace, preparing it for controlled transfer and execution within the lab.
Stage a benign tool artifact for later lab‑only transfer, ensuring the tool is ready and safe for use in the lab environment.
Stage a benign web target on the private laboratory network, setting up a safe landing page for subsequent visit and interaction.
Visit the declared lab page without delivering an exploit, verifying HTTP request logging and ensuring no malicious activity occurs.
Transfer the staged benign tool through the declared private channel, confirming hash matching and safe delivery to the target host.
